notes.title: Update 1.530. Multiplayer patch.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7189485/3979a38b1f0e68356aa72f261be5343d6e2648f1.jpg

List of changes :

Bug fixes:
-QF 18 pounder no longer consumes high-explosive shells when firing shrapnel shells.
-Gun carrier can now elevate its gun to the maximum firing range

Multiplayer fixes

-Removed artillery from "no artillery" preset
-Added Italian and American machine gun to "only infantry mode"
-Returned heavy infantry to "Control points" mode, cost is 12
-All light mortars have equal 6 sec reload time
-8cm Feldkanone and Cannone da 75 guns now have 55 HE and 10 shrapnel shells in multiplayer
-Saint-Chamond tank frontal armor increased to 12mm
-Tankegewehr armor penetration raised +4mm
-Heavy MG command points reduced from 25 to 15
-All elite squads have officer replaced by an elite soldier. This allows them to use speed boost
-Reduced amount of shrapnel shells in all field guns from 25 to 10 to decrease shrapnel spam that was hindering infantry gameplay. To compensate the amount of HE shells increased from 50 to 55.
-All engineer squads now only have 1 grenade per soldier

Multiplayer factions balance fixes

Austria-Hungary:
-Jager with sniper rifle replaced by a regular jager, cost of squad +2
-Bosnian infantry cost +3
-AA truck cost +10, command points +4 cooldown +10
-Skoda 75mm gun range increased by 15 meters, cost reduced by 10 points
-225mm mortar cost reduced by 11 points

Italy:
-Fiat 2k price +20, cooldown +15, command points +10
-Carcano rifle damage now same as all other rifles
-Howitzer cost reduced from 115 to 100 points
-Soldiers rifle ammo count increased from 90 to 150

Germany:
-Jagers now have same amount of ammo as riflemen
-Jagers speed increased from 0.9 to 1.1 
-Stormtroopers now have same health as stormtroopers in other factions (from 150 to 300)
-21cm Mörser cost reduced from 160 to 140 points
-25cm mortar cost reduced by 11 points

USA
-Grenadiers cooldown no longer resets when you buy riflemen
-Marines now have same health as stormtroopers in other factions (from 150 to 300)
-Marines and grenadiers cost reduced by 2 points

Britain:
-Gun Carrier removed from defenders team in Frontline mode

France:
-22cm Mortier cost reduced from 160 to 140 points

notes.content:
https://pp.vk.me/c631129/v631129691/2c309/sCxeURFdnwM.jpg

Attention! Today we are starting the competition for the best map for "Battle of Empires: 1914-1918"!

The prize: the key for standard version of any game on Steam, at the request of the winner.

Details:

The competition is divided into three phases. Working with map, the publication of the work, voting.

First step. Working with map.

From 05.17.2016 till 06.07.2016 any modder able to develop map any size. One main condition -  "Control points" mode should work on your map correctly.

Your task - to create a map and configure it for this mode. You will have exactly 20 days for this step. How many modes to customize further - totally up to you, but  "Control points" must be working.

Second step. Publication of the work.

From 06.08.2016 till 06.10.2016 - the time of publication of works on Steam Workshop. Each work must be represented as a separate package, and meet the requirements that are described in this manual.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=393655131

From 1 modder we are taking ONLY 1 map with a mandatory mode "Control points".

Note that to be able to participate in this competition your work should be already uploaded on Steam Workshop at 23:59 GMT, 06.10.2016. It's also should be INVISIBLE for the players. Also it MUST be marked by special tag "Competition".

All works that do not meet the above requirements will be disqualified, as well as their authors. All works that will be published before or after the second step with the tag "Competition" will be removed from the Steam Workshop, and the authors will also not be admitted to the competition.

Third step. Voting.

Everything is simple. From 06.11.2016 till 06.17.2016 players will subscribing to your mod, playing and putting the rating on Steam Workshop. How do we will determine the winner? It's also simple - we will choose the tag "Competition" and choose Sort by "Top Rated All Time". The first map in list it's our winner.

06.11.2016 developers will open access to all works from competition for players. 06.18.2016 developers will announce the winner.

The author may ask to remove his work from the competition at any stage. He should just to write to our community manager - A'Krist.

The developers also reserving the right to remove any work from the competition at any stage.

Be attentive - the prize is the standard version of the game from Steam. That means  the prize ARE NOT ABLE to be some special "Collector's edition", any bundle, software or special entertainment product. It is also can not be Steam Workshop Item or in-game currency for "Free to Play" games, as well as paid content or services of any kind of F2P games.

All requests, questions, comments and suggestions, you can write bellow in the comments.

notes.title: “Real War” is HERE!
notes.content:
https://pp.vk.me/c604330/v604330691/54fa/tND1kavbWCc.jpg

Good afternoon, dear players.
Are you over 18 already? If not, turn away from the screen.
Others can read further.
Introducing package «Real War», a new Free DLC!.
In it - the horrors of war, as they are - rivers of blood, severed hands, feet and head,
Want more? The impact of poisonous gases on flora and soldiers without masks. The chance of catching a cold, infect everyone around and die.
And more? Chance to get wounded on the barbed wire.
More? Fire spreads now stronger and burns everything in its path.
And also, hated enemy are able to receive a last bullet from your dying soldier.

DLC consists of two parts: package "Blood and limbs" is responsible for the blood, limbs, diseases, new animations of death, etc. Package "Real War" is responsible for the new super-realistic settings. Want to experience the real difficulties of the war? Do not forget to enable "Real War" after "Blood and limbs". Now the enemy will not forgive your mistakes!

Details:

Package "Blood and limbs":
- Rivers of blood
- Separation of limbs
- An expanded list of death animations
- Agony of the dying soldier in the final moments of his life
- An improved system of distribution of fire
- The reaction of the soldiers at the severed limbs, corpses and gas
- The effect of water on the health of the soldier (the soldiers going into the water can get cold, which could lead to his death, a slow and painful, soldier can also infect others soldiers)
- Barbed wire is able to immobilize a soldier and cause bleeding, which may kill him
- The impact of gases on vegetation

Package “Real War”:
New level of difficulty in singleplayer
New level of difficulty in multiplayer
Multiplayer settings are closer to the singleplayer setting.
Increased accuracy of rifles
Accuracy of the guns is reduced
The range of rifles and machine guns increased to 100 meters
Infantry sight range is increased

Packages are independent from each other. To enable new settings of weapons - select package "Real War" in the game options.
To enable the diseases, a new death animations, etc. - select package "Blood and limbs" in the game options.

By the way… who noticed that little fact  that DLC was available for all day long? ;)

notes.title: Attention! Important information about critical errors!
notes.content:
Dear players, if your game crashed with a critical error, please use the "report form" that is included into our project. In this way you increase the chances of early detection and speed of correction of the error. At the same time, you save your  own time and don't spend it on the description of the problem, because all the information we need, contained in the report sent by system. This report formed by the game by using the "report form".
Here is detailed photo instruction how you can send us all the necessary info. Also you can regulate what kind of information to send to our servers. 
We guarantee the safety of all the information that you will forward to us. It will be used only to identify the problems and will only be stored on our servers.

1. If your game crashed with a critical error - press "Send report"

2. Press the "Send" button in the window that appears. The game will create the necessary reports and send them to our server. You can deselect individual variants, but we recommend to leave all that marked by an automatic system. The more information we will get from this report, the faster we will fix the problem.

3. Copy the data from the field "User Info" and leave it in this discussion 

steamcommunity.com/app/316430/discussions/0/541906989390417305/

4. Wait for the sending of the report.

5. Copy the ticket id and leave it in this discussion 

steamcommunity.com/app/316430/discussions/0/541906989390417305/

notes.title: Update 1.434 + Austria-Hungary in Multiplayer game
notes.content:
Dear players!
Today we have released the update 1.434 that adds a new nation to the Multiplayer of Battle of Empires- Austria-Hungary! 

Yes, you heard it right - Austria-Hungary as an independent nation is now in Multiplayer!
Gameplay of Austria-Hungary is somewhat different from other nations, due to a unique set of units. Players will test their skill in controlling infantry, artillery and light vehicles, to challenge the rest of the nations.
You will have unique units under your command - such as mountain jaegers, Bosnian infantry, Benz light car with a machine gun, 75mm mountain gun, heavy 225mm mortar and 150mm howitzer. Prove that not only tanks rule the battlefield!

Austria-Hungary is waiting for you on the battlefields of Battle of Empires!

In addition, this patch also includes other fixes and enhancements:
* Fixed a bug with opening of the entire map after loading a save
* Fixed a bug with the crash of the game while viewing the corpses using V button.

notes.title: Textures in Gem2 (note for mod-makers)
notes.content:
General principles:

1. Textures on models have to be with a full set of mips
DXT1 - if there is one-bit alpha or no alpha at all  
DXT5 - if there is a complete alpha (windows, other objects with a translucent surfaces)

Examples:

/entity/constrution/entourage/brand_gate_right_t2/walls_bg03.tga: few mip levels (1 of 11)
or
/entity/construction/town_hall/common/2166701526_9b03d6f418.bmp: few mip levels (1 of 9) 
Need to resave in the dds format with all mips

/texture/common/construction/bridge_basis#1.dds: few mip levels (3 of 10)
The chain of saved mips is incomplete, need to save once more with a full set of mips

2. Textures of the interface and service sprite objects should be without mips, thus  such formats as jpg png tga bmp or dds without mips can be used.
Backgrounds, mini-maps, loading screens, preview images - can be saved in jpg with the maximum quality

Examples:
/entity/service/map_point/tex0_0.dds: extra mip levels (3)
Need to be resaved without mips
/interface/scene/structure/ba64/scheme.tga and portraits of the units - to do nothing

3. Textures with alpha in tga format must always be 32-bit

notes.title: Important note for mod-makers!
notes.content:
Attention! To prevent the instable operation of mods we make all mods marked as "incompatible". Authors of the mods should be familiar with important information and fix the mods according to the technical requirements!
After fixing the mod, the author must report about it (either via news or by a personal message to developers), after which the mod will be re-opened.

Important note for mod-makers with the latest patch 1.431. Some engine settings have benn changed, especially important is that the game considers uppercase and lowercase letters in file names! Read all points carefully:

No more automatic conversion of resource names to low case! Now names should fit exactly, or you will get “resource not found”. 
All styles from many *.lng gathered in one #skin.lng (in base resources) 
Clippers now configured and stored in mission files 
Able to use different mission files for different team sizes in multiplayer games
You have to rename all multiplayer mission names in battle zones mode from battle_zones.mi to battlezones.mi

VERY IMPORTANT point! With the newest patch the game engine became case-sensitive. To avoid misunderstandings we highly recommended to use lowercase (small) letters in all the names!
http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/322375642206586134/512A11718A26E8EE3EB55B900627DD972A1CCDB9/

Localization
If you want to make a multi-language version of your mod, it is necessary to to create separate folders for each language (.ru, .en, .fr, .de, .es), whose structure is the same as the global directory, so it will have folders “interface» (for texts) and «sound» (for voice dialogs)
Please note that is not needed to copy full localization file to your mod, if it is necessary to add the names of new units or change the existing description. To do this, create a file with the correct name, but add at the end of the name the + sign. The game is able to merge the original file with additional file with same name. Merging of files takes place in order of packages (!)

Inheritance package properties
It is absolutely necessary to specify the ID of the packages in .info file, that are required for your package and exclude the connection of the packages which can have a conflict.
Packages are applied in the same order in which packages are specified in lines 
{dependency "....."}
Add this line into your .info file so that the package manager does not go crazy - 
{default_disabled}

Folders «global» and «scene» in your mod folder
«Global» folder contains all the resources that are connected at the time of loading of the game and which are necessary for the correct operation of the interface (modes, maps, interface files, lists of units for regimes, plus music and sounds)
«Scene» - it's resources for the game scenes (entity, environment, breed, stuff, etc.)

Package activation (important)!
By default, your package will be activated every time you create a session on any map of your mod. To avoid confusion with the connection of the necessary packages always name your maps with as long names as possible. For example, in the name of the map, you can add the name of your mod or map author to avoid the same map name issue.

United States of America added as an independent faction in multiplayer.
Belgian infantry added in the ranks of the French army.

Improved gameplay

Fixed error with setting up items (such as barbed wire and sandbags) - all items are now installed on the same principle in two modes: in sections while holding the right mouse button, and one by one while holding shift (see training video)
Fixed bug with ‘steam_appid.txt’ appearance resulting the game does not start.
Fixed bug that may significantly drop FPS
Fixed error with setting up items (such as barbed wire and sandbags) - all items are now installed on the same principle in two modes: in sections while holding the right mouse button, and one by one while holding shift (see training video)

Improved “Create session password” window design
For mod-makers
No more automatic conversion of resource names to low case! Now names should fit exactly, or you will get “resource not found”.
All styles from many *.lng gathered in one #skin.lng (in base resources)
Clippers now configured and stored in mission files
Able to use different mission files for different team sizes in multiplayer games

Mission fixes
2nd mission of the Russian campaign - fixed bug with infinite allies
7th mission of the Russian campaign - fixed bug with the non-starting German attack

Austrian armored car Junovicz added to the game resources
New vehicles for the United States: 6-ton tank M1917, armoured car White m1917, heavy machine gun Browning.

notes.title: “Real War” package coming soon!
notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/34.jpg

Good afternoon, dear players.
Are you over 18 already? If not, turn away from the screen.
Others can read further.

Introducing package «Horrors of war», a new FREE DLC!

In it - the horrors of war, as they are - rivers of blood, severed hands, feet and head,
And more - the impact of poisonous gases on flora and soldiers without masks. The chance of catching a cold, infect everyone around and die.
Chance to get wounded on the barbed wire.
Fire spreads now stronger and burns everything in its path.

To complete the picture turn on the “Real war“ package.
The enemy is shooting better. All weapons fire at longer distances. The enemy will not forgive your mistakes.

Details:

Package "Blood and limbs":
- Rivers of blood
- Separation of limbs
- An expanded list of death animations
- Agony of the dying soldier in the final moments of his life
- An improved system of distribution of fire
- The reaction of the soldiers at the severed limbs, corpses and gas
- The effect of water on the health of the soldier (the soldiers going into the water can get cold, which could lead to his death, a slow and painful, soldier can also infect others soldiers)
- Barbed wire is able to immobilize a soldier and cause bleeding, which may kill him
- The impact of gases on vegetation

“Real War” package:
- Multiplayer settings are closer to the singleplayer setting.
- Increased accuracy of rifles
- Accuracy of the guns is reduced
- The range of rifles and machine guns increased to 100 meters
- Infantry sight range is increased

notes.title: Developer Diaries
notes.content:
https://pp.vk.me/c625618/v625618314/44754/y54znlVEDsc.jpg

Dear friends! We would like to congratulate all of you with the anniversary of the end of the WW1! November 11, 1918 Armistice of Compiègne was signed. As a result of this war four empires have ceased to exist: Russian, German, Austro-Hungarian and Ottoman.
But today we're not going to talk about the lessons that humanity must learn as a consequence of these horrific events, we want to tell you more about process of development Battle of Empires and about the challenges we faced in that moment. 

How to start working on campaign?

“The ideas themselves are good but they are worth nothing without people who can perform them.”
These words of Henry Ford, every one of us (the authors of the game) considers 100% truthful. Especially considering that we are the very same people.
Everything starts from the Idea.
Let’s take as example the campaign for Russia.
That’s to say a plotless campaign - no general heroes and no any general storyline.
Why it came like this?
The development of any campaign starts with determining the number of missions and identification of the main battles and fights that we would like to show in the game. In the case of the campaign for Russia, we immediately faced with many difficulties that had to be overcome. Firstly, not every battle or fight left its mark on history. Secondly, sometimes it is impossible to make an interesting mission within the engine of those left battles. A classic example - "Attack of the Dead" from Osowiec. The mission was planned, but after we realized that in order to implement it we need a large-scale intervention in the engine (it would be necessary to change ready AI so as to perform the AI of empoisoned characters and their enemies), models (needed the empoisoned models) and new animations of empoisoned. It was decided to illustrate the siege of Ivangorod - our resources (mostly temporary) - are not unlimited.
In general, during development of the plan for the campaign and selection of suitable battles, head script writer takes into account many factors.
1. The necessary resources for missions - the list of new content.
2. The complexity of the implementation of events of the battle on the level of scripting and partly on design level.
3. Creation of the exciting atmosphere inside the mission - the large amount battles of WWI took place on the scenario: the enemy is ahead and why don’t we send a couple of regiments on him? Oh, everybody was killed? Then - a couple of divisions! Did not help? Then we send 10 divisions! You understand that to reflect the endless rush of infantry can be interesting one time ... Well, maximum 3 times.
4. It would be great, all things being equal, to choose the battles that led to the victory. Hardly anyone would want to command troops of XX Army Corps in winter 1914, knowing that the battle ended in defeat. Although ... that is the most important point of script writer skill - to find a loophole in a similar situation.
5. Time, time and time. It is a very serious factor. To test a mission with 30 minutes of game time is necessary to spend about 50 hours of testing. And for the mission in three stages, such as the storming of Buchach (Kara Celestial) – many times more.
Be in touch - in the future we will tell you how to we were looking for battles, how historical figures were chosen for their introduction into the game and we continue to talk about the challenges of development.

notes.title: Workshop Alert!
notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/31.jpg

In the next 24 hours in response to increasing cases of game client crashes because of incorrectly configured mods we will perform preventive shutdown of all mods in the BoE Steam Workshop, as long as their authors do not set the dependence to one of the base packages and add the image of their package.

For this you have to add dependency to one of the basic packages into .info file in your package. If your package is built on the resources of the World War I, add dependency to boe1914-basic package:
[code]{dependency "41e706a0-4047-42e0-810d-02f721d569bd"}[/code]

If your package is built on the resources of World War II, add the following dependencies:
[code]{dependency "a3765f2e-d0bb-4303-aa69-713e60c8557d"}; ww2-set
{dependency "8dc3ce70-7634-42f6-89be-cd2ff857db08"}; boe1914-core[/code]

In addition, make an image for your package. This image should be put next to your .info file, be named preview.jpg and have a resolution of 512x515 px.

After adding the appropriate bindings and image, upload your package on the Steam Workshop using the package manager in the game and write a comment to this message — we will enable your mod.

Soon we will publish guides how to setup difficulty levels for mods developers.

На русском: 
В ближайшие 24 часа в связи с участившимися случаями падения клиента игры из-за неправильно настроенных модов мы произведем профилактическое отключение всех модов в BoE Steam Workshop, пока их авторы не проставят зависимость от одного из базовых пакетов и не добавят изображение для своего пакета.

Для этого  файле .info вашего пакета добавьте зависимость от одного из базовых пакетов. Если ваш пакет построен на ресурсах Первой мировой, поставьте зависимость от пакета boe1914-basic:
[code]{dependency "41e706a0-4047-42e0-810d-02f721d569bd"}[/code]

Если ваш пакет построен на ресурсах Второй мировой, пропишите следующие зависимости:
[code]{dependency "a3765f2e-d0bb-4303-aa69-713e60c8557d"} ; ww2-set
{dependency "8dc3ce70-7634-42f6-89be-cd2ff857db08"} ; boe1914-core[/code]

Кроме этого, сделайте заставку для вашего пакета. Это изображение должно лежать рядом с вашим файлом .info, называться preview.jpg и иметь разрешение 512x515 px.

После добавления зависимостей и изображения, загрузите ваш пакет на Steam Workshop при помощи менеджера пакетов в игре и напишите комментарий к данному сообщению - мы разблокируем ваш мод.

Скоро мы выложим гайды для разработчиков модов по настройке уровней сложности.

notes.title: Full Singleplayer Package now Available!
notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/30.jpg

Friends!
As you requested, we have made a package “Full Singleplayer” for those who bought a multiplayer package and want to upgrade it to the full game.
From today onwards, the complete formula of the game is as follows:
Base Game  + Season Pass  = Full Game
Multiplayer only  + Full Single  = Full Game

http://store.steampowered.com/app/390320/

At this point, the game already has amassed large amounts of content compared to other games based on the Gem2 engine:
 4 full-story campaigns, each of which has its own characteristics! All 36 missions can be also played in cooperative game mode (with friends)!
 4 nations in multiplayer: France, Germany, the Russian Empire and Britain.
 4 standard game modes: Frontline, Control points, Free fight and Victory flag.
 5 innovative game modes: Survival, Encounter battle, Rebellion, Trench assault and Team defence, the latter two in the shape of a cooperative game vs AI bots. 
 2 large-scale reenactment battles based on real events (Special mode): Battle of Cambrai in 1918, and the Battle for Berlin in 1945!
 In the editor, you have access to units of two wars: WWI and WWII to create mods on both eras, covering the period of history from 1914 to 1945!

In the near future we will release another campaign — German Empire, which offers new theaters of war and new enemies: the Serbs, Bulgarians, Italians and Arabian rebels - and new allies: the Turks, Bulgarians and Austrians. German Campaign will be part of the Season Pass and Full Single, and will also be available as a separate DLC for those who do not want to buy everything.

At this point, our game has the most powerful post-release support from developers for Gem2 engine-based games. And it was made possible thanks to your support! We love you, we read your comments, complaints and suggestions. We will develop the game further and we are willing to craft further content for you!

notes.title: Skirmish Pack: defend, attack, counterattack!
notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/28.jpg
We have excellent news for those who requested and waited for the skirmish gamemode, as well as for those who supported the project and acquired a Season Pass.

The new package “Skirmish Pack” contains two modes that give dual experiences for both single and teamwork face-off against the AI. 

This DLC is part of the Season Pass, and it can also be purchased separately.

Trench warfare is a distinctive feature of the First World War. Together with your friends you have to confront a very tricky opponent under the computer’s control. Defend, attack, counterattack! Use gas shells, heavy howitzers, flanking maneuvers of the light armored vehicles and frontal assaults using heavy tanks! Do not forget to use searchlights to locate the enemy.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X_LnC8yZaS8
In the "Trench assault" mode, players will assault fortified enemy AI positions and seize control points. The game continues running until the players capture all the control points or the timer expires in 90 minutes. Number of active enemy AI bots depends on the number of players. The intensity and strength of the enemy fortifications depends on the difficulty level.

In the "Team defense" mode, players will defend their positions from constant assaults. The main task of the players is to hold the flag. The game ends when the enemy captures the player’s flag or the player successfully fights off the last attack of AI.

notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/28.jpg
We have excellent news for those who requested and waited for the skirmish gamemode, as well as for those who supported the project and acquired a Season Pass.

The new package “Skirmish Pack” contains two modes that give dual experiences for both single and teamwork face-off against the AI. 

This DLC is part of the Season Pass, and it can also be purchased separately.

Trench warfare is a distinctive feature of the First World War. Together with your friends you have to confront a very tricky opponent under the computer’s control. Defend, attack, counterattack! Use gas shells, heavy howitzers, flanking maneuvers of the light armored vehicles and frontal assaults using heavy tanks! Do not forget to use searchlights to locate the enemy.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X_LnC8yZaS8
In the "Trench assault" mode, players will assault fortified enemy AI positions and seize control points. The game continues running until the players capture all the control points or the timer expires in 90 minutes. Number of active enemy AI bots depends on the number of players. The intensity and strength of the enemy fortifications depends on the difficulty level.

In the "Team defense" mode, players will defend their positions from constant assaults. The main task of the players is to hold the flag. The game ends when the enemy captures the player’s flag or the player successfully fights off the last attack of AI.

notes.title: Reenact the cruical battle of Cambrai in 1918! Free DLC!
notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/26.jpg

troops.  The Alliance of Britain, Canada and New Zealand on one side and Germany on the other. Two infantry divisions against three hundred tanks. Everything has already been decided. Or not?

We give you the chance to re-live the mighty battle, and march to victory, or to rewrite history and halt the Entente on their feet  and return the lands that no longer belong to them.
Everything depends on you!

http://store.steampowered.com//app/396440


 Install this DLC, then start the game. 
 In "Settings> Packages" check whether the package is downloaded, and proceed to activate it if so. 
 Then, select "Network" (Network)> "New Game", and in the drop-down menu "game type" , select "Special", where you will find the mission.

notes.title: A statement from the developers of BoE!
notes.content:
We released the Multiplayer-only version (which is less expensive than full version) due to the fact that many players wanted to play only in multiplayer and single-player campaigns didn’t  interest them. We left the possibility to buy the campaigns in the form of DLC for the owners of MP-only version, if they want to play co-op or single.

So, we have provided a flexible purchasing system that allows you to choose the optimal configuration of BoE, at a reasonable price according to your play style and budget.

This allows you to enhance the game with additional content by purchasing DLC’s individually, or as a package.

The  Multiplayer package (Battle of Empires: 1914-1918. Multiplayer-only - base price $4.99) includes:
Tutorial missions 
Mutliplayer MP Pack 1 & MP Pack 2 (4 nations, 7 game modes, skirmish - battles against AI, more than 20 mp maps, ww2 units set and historical reconstruction "Battle of Berlin")
Basic mp Steam workshop content is available with this package (you still need to subscribe to the workshop content).
Note:  The Editor is not included in the MP version.

To gain access to the editor, single and cooperative missions from the Steam Workshop, for the muliplayer version,  you need to purchase at least one single-player campaign ( i.e. France, or Russian Empire or Blazing guns or Season Pass). 

The basic package (Battle of Empires: 1914-1918 - base price $19.99) includes:
Training missions
French Campaign
Russian Empire Campaign
Mutliplayer with MP Pack 1 & MP Pack 2 (4 nations, 7 game modes, skirmish - battles against AI, more than 20 mp maps, ww2 units set and historical reconstruction "Battle of Berlin")
Editor. 
All BoE Steam Workshop content is available with this package (you still need to subscribe to workshop content).

For the basic package it is advisable to purchase the Season Pass (British, German and Blazing guns campaigns), which includes all the subsequent campaigns. 

Thank you for your love!

notes.title: Skirmish, MOBA and "Multiplayer ONLY" package coming soon!
notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/mp_pack2.jpg
Thanks to your feedback, we have revised our plans for "DLC MP-Pack 2" and we have good news: we will include the new DLC into all packages absolutely free!
The owners of both Early Access and release version game will get new multiplayer modes and maps for free with the next update.

Rebellion Mode- a third party is now involvd in combat, which can directly influence the outcome of the match - urban militia. Armed local people have dug in on the narrow streets of the city and took up defensive positions in houses, can pose a real challenge to the players and serve as a major obstacle to achieving victory in the match.
Moreover, a variety of side quests are now available for the players, which allow to earn extra points for his team.
This mode also provides the opportunity to battle against the AI (skirmish).

Encounter battle (MOBA) - controlling only vehicles, player must use all his skills in the direct control destroying enemy vehicles to turn the tide of battle and ultimately annihilate the enemy base, providing support for the Allied infantry. This mode is made in the genre of MOBA

Survival Mode - for how long can you hold the position against constantly increasing enemy offensive? Can you survive all 20 waves of enemy, that constantly strengthens its onslaught? You can test your strength in the new mode.

Your feedback helps us to understand the player’s expectations and develop our game in the right way to make it better for you.
So we are  going to keep track of which mode you like more (based on the number of active matches in different modes, as well as on the reviews) and add new maps to your favorite modes .

Great News
In order to attract new players to the multiplayer, we plan to release MULTIPLAYER ONLY version of the game with fair price.

notes.title: Special present for the Victory in Europe Day - FREE DLC
notes.content:
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/vp_1.jpg

The 70 year anniversary of the victory over the Third Reich by the allied forces, is near. In honor of this momentous event, we decided to release a free DLC with a multiplayer mission "Battle for Berlin". In this mode you will be able to play either as a Red Army officer and assault  the heart of the Third Reich or  as a Wehrmacht commander, trying to hold back the Red Army offensive.
https://youtu.be/hnsh_eQz64E

The reconstruction mission is a multiplayer game. The game supports player  sessions from 1x1 to 4x4. When an unequal team count occurs, the game compensates for the missing team’s units by placing them under the control of the AI.

Fan made Gameplay trailer here
https://youtu.be/rUyEkxMuTwo
=======================================
To start a historical reconstruction mission, you need to install the free DLC from the library page of the store.
http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/help_0.jpg

http://store.steampowered.com/app/342010/

(We did not include the reconstruction of the content from the base game, bearing in mind large additions. The DLC contains the resources of the Second World War - we hope mod makers will tell us your thoughts on this content, and thank you for it in advance. This package makes it possible to create mods for the game - Battle of Empires based on the Second World war.)

For easy starting of the  multiplayer Battle for Berlin historical reconstruction, we have created a separate launcher, which automatically connect all the necessary packages for the game to run.

http://battle-of-empires.com/phocagallery/for_steam/help_1.jpg

Run “Battle of Berlin”  as follows:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dfJ1ykUCTgg

Pay attention!
When you run “Battle of Berlin”, the packages related to the base game: Battle of Empires, are automatically disabled, but they are still available to you. The game automatically connects them when you connect to any session with the game on the original resource for game “Battle of Empires”, or start the game from any actual game saves from "Battle of the Empires/
https://youtu.be/vewedMow-jg

notes.content:

Hello, friend and subscribers! Today we are glad to intronduce Update 1,3 to you. 

What’s very pleasant in the the update 1.3:
The lobby now has a general chat. Chat works through the official clan game Steam group chat. We also made Unicode support to texts, so different languages are displayed correctly for all players. 
You can go to the profile of player you are interested in straight from the game room and the lobby.

“Invite Friend” button now works corectly.
An information icon in the lobby in the game list, with detailed information about each session is added.
Information about the number of players in the game, and the group is displayed now.
The game displays the number of tokens earned by the player. Tokens are awarded only for purchase of additional content, but in this area we have plans.
Added the localization of French missions (subtitles)

Finalization of game mechanics:
Units are now able to properly run behind the commander into the shelter. 
Units are now able to be allocated on the area where the detachment moved.
Fixed crashes in co-op in the distribution of units between the players.

In the current update we paid attention to the convenience of Front-End Interface and best prepared for the introduction of the game workshop.
In this regard, the internal structure of folders of the game is changed. Therefore, to avoid a crash it is recommend to delete the content of the folder with the game completely (make sure that all the files and folders are deleted) and install the game again.

Now you can connect and disconnect the content to the basic game. To do this, the game was divided into logically complete parts (packages). Active players will be able to evaluate this new quality of the game, when they start to use the additional content of the workshop. The game is now able to detect conflicting modules that make the work of the game with connected modes more stable.
The game also learned to identify matching resources with different configurations of plug-mods, if the mod does not affect the resources used in the session. What does it gives to ordinary players? No need to unplug mods, if you want to play the original maps and missions in co-op and multiplayer.



Added

+ Mgebrov-Renault armored car model
+ 22cm Schneider mortier howitzer model
+ 25cm Schwerer Minenwerfer mortar model
+ Maps Ribecourt, Champagne, Augustow Forest, Baranovitchi
+ New mode of the Free Fight
+ Taught the game to load configuration files, depending on the loaded map
+ Added Unicode support (texts in any language will be displayed correctly)
+ Have laid the foundation for the Workshop - performed reconfiguration of structure of resources for the future system of comfortable mods
+ Game lobby chat
+ Transition from the lobby to the profile of the player you are interrested by
+ Information icon for a list of sessions in the lobby
+ Re-recorded voices in campaign missions
+ Taught soldiers to run after the commander to the shelter, keeping a distance
+ Ability to run a multiplayer maps by single player 
+ Ukrainian and French localization (partially)
+ Reworked models of British infantry

Changed\fixed

* Improved Front-End and lobby user interface 
* Taught the game to determine the mismatch of resources - given as an information window indicating the differing resources
* Fixed a crash with desync when autoasign units in the co-op mode
* Configured lighting in the multiplayer maps
* Returned the installation of sandbags on guns and mortars in multiplayer.
* Fixed some minor bugs in the the French campaign, including broken Achievements
* Fixed unbreakable right track of the MK VIII tank.
* Fixed the sound of the horses (quieter and without noise now)
* Improved the localization of missions (bug fixes, aligned with the voice acting)

Balancing

* Stormtroopers timer increased, range reduced, also added restriction in the the front line to 2 squads
* Set the timer for the heavy machinery for the front line and other modes


Further plans:

! The campaign "Russian Empire"
! Steam WorkShop
! New multiplayer maps
! New models of Austrian infantry

FAQ

1. Game does not starts, shows error “termination access violation”
You need to completelly delete the game (include profile) and reinstall it.

2. Game crashes with “termination access violation” whenuploading additional maps and\or mods
On startup game checks the integrity and legality of resources, so when it detects unauthorized changes of game resources, it stops with a warning. All modes and additional maps, as well as any modifications of resources must be made in the form of a package.
We have added an example “boe1914-sample”, you can find it inside “packages” folder.

notes.title: Be ready for Early World War One!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/316430/ss_9c71b79bbc3c6774485d9b6c1434eb0a50373661.1920x1080.jpg?t=1417735870

Friends and subscribers!
We are glad to tell you that Steam integration process for our game is close to the end. Now we are getting everything ready to make the game available in Early Access to make finishing multiplayer and voiceover possible.

Our page is already visible as “Coming Soon” in Early Access section. Despite the fact that our programmers, producer and actors completed most of the work during last two months, the Great War Team hadn’t been just chilling out. We had been preparing game resources, editing texts again and again, testing missions and fixing small bugs.
Recently one of members of our team visited the only WWI museum in Russia. We have made several game objects based on the materials exposed there!

http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/35231100281638940/4F7A4331C1174ACB9E735A1011E3CC31738D0A94/1024x576.resizedimage
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/316430/ss_9bad832fa5bb370755d5dc41bffa472d137d061c.1920x1080.jpg?t=1417735870

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/316430/ss_be1add43ebf9a8b5f68e14a34cbcc5475da43f42.1920x1080.jpg?t=1417735870

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/316430/ss_7a01a0f1b8200fa18594aa29156b2eff7fdccd70.1920x1080.jpg?t=1417735870

So, what waits you in Early Acces?

You will have to lead French soldiers to victory in wide variety of dynamic missions ranging from stealth operations to battles involving hundreds of soldiers.
Different approaches to accomplishing tasks. Will you crush your enemies or silently outflank them?
Realistic combat. Your soldiers are not superheroes, they are real people who are not able to withstand several shots and continue fighting as usual. Every game object(including bushes, trees, buldings, debris or even vehicles) can become a viable tactical spot that will cover your soldiers from enemy fire.
Dynamic vehicle damage system. Vehicle have no hitpoints,instead their parts(turret, cannon,tracks or the hull itself) can be damaged by artillery fire.
This game features destructible environment and RPG features including inventory management and character personalization as well as vehicle direct control. Immersive effects and authentic soldier equipment let you dive into the battlefields of one of the biggest wars of our time, making choices that will result in glorious victory or shameful defeat.
Join the Early Access, unleash the power of game editor and participate in final stage of game development. Best maps from community will be included in the final release in multiplayer mode.


More new screenshots for you!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/316430/ss_465f286c475449778d8f3deccf26e1b17106e61b.jpg?t=1417726035

If you have any questions, be free to ask them. Detailed information is available on our website where you can find some precious background papers.

Battle of Empires 1914-1918 is a tactical strategy about combat operations during WWI. Players are leading their sodiers to victory in dynamic missions ranging from stealth operations to huge battles with tanks, artillery and dozens of units.
